purpose: Sound requests for the Unity Chip Arena effects bank (owner, 2026-10-15). A generator (e.g. ElevenLabs Sound Effects, run by the owner with their own API key, never committed) reads this; the importer converts '<key>_NN.<ext>' files into the LocalAssets bank.
naming: <key>_NN.<mp3|wav>, NN from 01; one distinct generation per file
suffix: isolated, dry close-mic recording, no reverb, no music, no background noise

notes.zombies: Zombies are infected people in torn clothes, not monsters: human throats gone wrong, raspy, wet and broken.
notes.priority: 1 = needed most (zombie voices), 2 = special zombies and zombie steps, 3 = optional (player steps already exist)
